newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves ModiLuft's $60 mln GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: India approves ModiLuft's $60 mln GDR issue.

text.p: India said on Friday it had approved a $60 million issue of international equity by private airline Modiluft Ltd.
The Indian cabinet approved the airline's proposal to attract foreign direct investment through the issue of global depositary receipts (GDRs) at a meeting on Friday, a government statement said.
Funds raised by the issue will be used to purchase new aircraft and expand the airline's operations, it said.

After the issue, the foreign equity holding in the airline will rise to 32.17 percent, or 292.9 million rupees, on enhanced equity capital of 910.2 million rupees, it said. It did not say what the current foreign holding was.
India's S.K. Modi group is the main stakeholder in ModiLuft.
